ucs.title: [LLM] APT28 (Forest Blizzard) Outlook NTLM coercion via CVE-2023-23397 — outbound SMB from outlook.exe to non-corporate IPs
ucs.description: Hunts the signature post-exploitation tell of APT28's CVE-2023-23397 campaign: a crafted Outlook calendar/task item with PidLidReminderFileParameter set to a UNC path forces outlook.exe to authenticate to an attacker-controlled SMB listener and leak the user's NTLMv2 hash. Microsoft (Forest Blizzard / STRONTIUM) and PL CERT attributed this technique to APT28 across 2022–2023 intrusions targeting government, energy, defense, and transportation orgs across NATO Europe.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where (All_Traffic.app="outlook.exe" OR All_Traffic.process_name="outlook.exe") All_Traffic.dest_port=445 by All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.user All_Traffic.dest All_Traffic.dest_port All_Traffic.app | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)` | where NOT (cidrmatch("10.0.0.0/8",dest) OR cidrmatch("172.16.0.0/12",dest) OR cidrmatch("192.168.0.0/16",dest) OR cidrmatch("100.64.0.0/10",dest) OR cidrmatch("169.254.0.0/16",dest)) | iplocation dest | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | table firstTime lastTime src user dest dest_port Country
ucs.kql:
// APT28 / Forest Blizzard CVE-2023-23397 NTLM coercion via Outlook reminder UNC
let Lookback = 30d;
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "outlook.exe"
| where RemotePort == 445
| where RemoteIPType == "Public"
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName,
          AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          AccountUpn  = InitiatingProcessAccountUpn,
          RemoteIP, RemotePort, RemoteUrl,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine, ReportId
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// APT28 / Forest Blizzard CVE-2023-23397 NTLM coercion via Outlook reminder UNC
// Requires Sysmon EventID 3 (network connect) ingested into WindowsEvent
WindowsEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon"
| where EventID == 3
| extend Image    = tostring(EventData.Image)
| extend DestIp   = tostring(EventData.DestinationIp)
| extend DestPort = toint(EventData.DestinationPort)
| extend User     = tostring(EventData.User)
| where Image endswith @"\outlook.exe"
| where DestPort == 445
| where not(DestIp startswith "10." or DestIp startswith "192.168." or DestIp matches regex @"^172\.(1[6-9]|2\d|3[01])\." or DestIp startswith "169.254." or DestIp matches regex @"^100\.(6[4-9]|[7-9]\d|1[01]\d|12[0-7])\.")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, User, Image, DestIp, DestPort
| order by TimeGenerated desc

ucs.title: [LLM] APT28 (Forest Blizzard) GooseEgg post-compromise loader — spoolsv.exe spawning scripting hosts with wayzgoose / execute.bat artifacts (CVE-2
ucs.description: Hunts execution of APT28's custom post-compromise tool 'GooseEgg', which Microsoft attributed exclusively to Forest Blizzard / STRONTIUM in April 2024. GooseEgg exploits a Print Spooler privilege-escalation flaw (CVE-2022-38028) to run an attacker-staged batch (execute.bat) and side-loaded DLL (wayzgoose<NN>.dll) as SYSTEM, then drops Mimikatz-style credential-stealers. Used against Ukrainian, Western European, and US government targets going back to at least 2019.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name="spoolsv.exe" Processes.process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","rundll32.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","regsvr32.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where match(process,"(?i)(wayzgoose|execute\.bat|\\spool\\drivers\\color\\|\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Vault\\)") OR match(process_path,"(?i)(\\spool\\drivers\\color\\|wayzgoose)") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | table firstTime lastTime dest user parent_process process
ucs.kql:
// APT28 / Forest Blizzard GooseEgg — CVE-2022-38028 Print Spooler exploitation
let Lookback = 30d;
let ScriptHosts = dynamic(["cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","rundll32.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","regsvr32.exe"]);
let GooseEggIOCs = dynamic(["wayzgoose","execute.bat",@"\spool\drivers\color\",@"\ProgramData\Microsoft\Vault\"]);
let SpawnEvents =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "spoolsv.exe"
    | where FileName in~ (ScriptHosts)
         or ProcessCommandLine has_any (GooseEggIOCs)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("splwow64.exe","drvinst.exe")
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName,
              AccountName, AccountSid,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildImage  = FolderPath,
              ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
              SHA256, ProcessId, ReportId;
let FileEvents =
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "spoolsv.exe"
    | where FileName matches regex @"(?i)(wayzgoose.*\.dll|execute\.bat)"
         or FolderPath has_any (GooseEggIOCs)
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, ActionType, FolderPath, FileName, SHA256,
              InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, ReportId;
SpawnEvents
| union FileEvents
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// APT28 / Forest Blizzard GooseEgg — CVE-2022-38028 Print Spooler exploitation
let ScriptHosts = dynamic([@"\cmd.exe",@"\powershell.exe",@"\pwsh.exe",@"\rundll32.exe",@"\wscript.exe",@"\cscript.exe",@"\mshta.exe",@"\regsvr32.exe"]);
let GooseEggIOCs = dynamic(["wayzgoose","execute.bat",@"\spool\drivers\color\",@"\ProgramData\Microsoft\Vault\"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName endswith @"\spoolsv.exe"
| where ParentProcessName !endswith @"\splwow64.exe"
| where NewProcessName has_any (ScriptHosts)
     or CommandLine has_any (GooseEggIOCs)
| project TimeGenerated, Computer,
          Account = TargetUserName,
          ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine,
          TokenElevationType
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT28 GooseEgg Print Spooler Exploitation (CVE-2022-38028)
id: 8f2d7c4a-3e91-4a8b-bc6f-fd2c1a7b9c44
status: experimental
description: Detects spoolsv.exe spawning script-host or LOLBin children with GooseEgg artifacts (wayzgoose, execute.bat, spool\\drivers\\color paths) \u2014 Forest Blizzard / APT28's bespoke post-compromise loader per Microsoft Threat Intelligence (April 2024).
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2024/04/22/analyzing-forest-blizzards-custom-post-compromise-tool-for-exploiting-cve-2022-38028-to-obtain-credentials/
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/29
tags:
  - attack.privilege_escalation
  - attack.t1068
  - attack.t1003.001
  - attack.g0007
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  parent_spool:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\spoolsv.exe'
  child_host:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
  ioc_strings:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'wayzgoose'
      - 'execute.bat'
      - '\spool\drivers\color\'
      - '\ProgramData\Microsoft\Vault\'
  filter_legit:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\splwow64.exe'
      - '\drvinst.exe'
  condition: parent_spool and (child_host or ioc_strings) and not filter_legit
falsepositives:
  - Third-party print driver installers spawning rundll32 against spool color directory (rare; review hashes)
level: critical
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\spoolsv.exe OR *\\SPOOLSV.EXE) (@Image:(*\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\RunDll32.exe OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\regsvr32.exe) OR @CommandLine:(*wayzgoose* OR *execute.bat* OR *spool\\drivers\\color* OR *ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Vault*)) -@ParentImage:(*\\splwow64.exe OR *\\drvinst.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/spoolsv\.exe/i
| NOT ParentBaseFileName=/splwow64\.exe|drvinst\.exe/i
| (ImageFileName=/\\(cmd|powershell|pwsh|rundll32|wscript|cscript|mshta|regsvr32)\.exe$/i OR regex("(?i)(wayzgoose|execute\\.bat|\\\\spool\\\\drivers\\\\color|\\\\ProgramData\\\\Microsoft\\\\Vault)", field=CommandLine))
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
ucs.rationale: spoolsv.exe spawning interactive script hosts is fundamentally abnormal — its legitimate children are limited to splwow64.exe, drvinst.exe, and a handful of signed printer helpers. Combining that parent constraint with the named artifacts Microsoft published in its Forest Blizzard / GooseEgg analysis (wayzgoose<NN>.dll, execute.bat, the spool\drivers\color staging path, ProgramData\Microsoft\Vault
